description: The 3-layer trust stack middleware for Trinity Guardian (ETHGlobal Tokyo 2026): Layer 1 ENS gate (EAC spend role + com.trinityguard.* text records on Sepolia), Layer 2 Intercepta checkpoint (live quick-scan-address / scan-token API), Layer 3 World ID approver (sandbox.auth.world.org, soft-fail escalation, server-side proof validation). Ordered checks, hard/soft fail semantics, fail-closed on every error path. Ports POC guardian.ts as skeleton with pluggable screen() providers. SRS: FR-10..FR-16, FR-20..FR-27, FR-30..FR-36, FR-40..FR-47, FR-70..FR-74.

userStories.title: Guardian core: typed verdicts and ordered pipeline
userStories.description: As an agent, I want checkPolicy(reqs, dailySpend) to run the 3 layers in order and return a typed GuardianVerdict, so I know whether to sign, escalate, or refuse.
acceptanceCriteria: src/guardian/index.ts exports createGuardian(config): Guardian with checkPolicy, requestApproval, readPolicy
GuardianVerdict { decision: pass|soft_fail|hard_fail, reasons: string[], layers: LayerResult[] } with per-layer detail (ens/intercepta/caps/worldId)
Layers execute in order: ENS → Intercepta → caps → (World ID via requestApproval)
Stops at first hard_fail — subsequent layers do not run
Returns soft_fail when any layer soft-fails (over perTxMax, yellow verdict, non-allowlisted payTo)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: FR-10..FR-12. Port POC guardian.ts checkPolicy() as the skeleton; GuardianVerdict type is the contract consumed by task-agent and task-ui.

userStories.title: Layer 1 — ENS gate: EAC role and text records
userStories.description: As an owner, I want the spend permission and policy limits to live on-chain (EAC role + text records on [agent].trinityguard.eth), so revoking role is a trustless kill switch.
acceptanceCriteria: src/guardian/ens.ts reads EAC 'spend' role via eth_call on Sepolia RPC
Revoked/missing role → hard_fail immediately (kill switch — Demo Act 4)
Reads com.trinityguard.perTxMax, com.trinityguard.dailyCap, com.trinityguard.asset from resolver text records
readPolicy(subname) returns PolicyFromENS for UI display
ENS read failure → hard_fail (fail-closed)
Subname pattern: [agent].trinityguard.eth
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: FR-20..FR-23, FR-24 (kill switch MUST), FR-25 (expiry SHOULD). Depends on ENSv2 contracts deployed on Sepolia — mock role read until infra lands.

userStories.title: Layer 2 — Intercepta live screening
userStories.description: As a guardian, I want to call the live Intercepta API on payTo and asset before signing, so flagged scam addresses and lookalike tokens are blocked.
acceptanceCriteria: src/guardian/intercepta.ts calls quick-scan-address on payTo and scan-token on asset (live API, Bearer auth)
Red verdict → hard_fail with Intercepta's reason string preserved
Yellow verdict → soft_fail
API timeout/unreachable → soft_fail (never auto-pass)
Reason displayed in verdict details for UI
No mocked Intercepta data in final build (FR-36)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: FR-30..FR-36. Base URL TBD from key onboarding docs — request key on day 0. Mock with POC blocklist until key arrives.

userStories.title: Caps check against on-chain limits
userStories.description: As a guardian, I want to compare amount against perTxMax and dailySpend+amount against dailyCap (both from ENS text records), so spending stays within mandate.
acceptanceCriteria: src/guardian/caps.ts checks amount > perTxMax → soft_fail reason
dailySpend + amount > dailyCap → hard_fail
Uses limits from Layer 1's ENS read (not hardcoded)
CapsLayerDetails exposes amount/perTxMax/dailySpend/dailyCap/overPerTx/overDaily for UI meter
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: FR-22, FR-71, FR-72. dailySpend passed in by agent (accumulator owned by task-agent per SRS FR-73).

userStories.title: Layer 3 — World ID approval flow
userStories.description: As an owner, I want to approve or deny soft-failed payments via World ID for Agents, so a human is the final gate for risky payments.
acceptanceCriteria: src/guardian/worldid.ts implements requestApproval(reqs, reasons): Promise<boolean>
Request includes amount, payTo, escalation reason
Uses World ID for Agents sandbox (sandbox.auth.world.org)
Server-side proof validation before returning true (backend, not client)
Approval is single-use — does not blanket-approve future payments
Deny → returns false, payment refused with logged reason (Demo Act 3)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: FR-40..FR-47. Register app on sandbox day 0. Fallback per SRS: IDKit mini app if sandbox setup stalls.

userStories.title: Fail-closed semantics across all layers
userStories.description: As a security reviewer, I want every error/timeout path to result in refusal or human escalation — never an automatic payment — so the system is safe by default.
acceptanceCriteria: Intercepta timeout → soft_fail (escalate to human)
ENS read failure → hard_fail
World ID proof validation failure → treated as deny
No code path returns pass as a fallback for an exception
Unit test or scripted check covers each fail-closed path
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: NFR-20 (revised), NFR-21, NFR-22. Fail-closed is the demo's core security claim.
